'''''The Tiger That Isn't: Seeing Through a World of Numbers''''' is a [[statistics]] book written by [[Michael Blastland]] and [[Andrew Dilnot]], the creator and presenter of [[BBC Radio 4]]'s ''[[More or Less (radio programme)|More or Less]]''.  Like the radio show, it addresses the misuse of statistics in politics and the media.

The book has received favourable reviews for the simple presentation of complicated ideas.<ref>[http://plus.maths.org/content/tiger-isnt Plus magazine], review by Marc West, December 2007</ref><ref>[https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2008/aug/10/politicalbooks3 ''The Observer''], Katie Toms, August 2008</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Holderness |first=Mike |date=2007-09-15 |title=Review: The Tiger that Isn't by Michael Blastland and Andrew Dilnot: New Scientist |journal=New Scientist |volume=195 |issue=2621 |pages=57 |doi=10.1016/S0262-4079(07)62352-5}}</ref>
